sample_policies.R: primary, nonvirtual-only ALL training/selection/preprocessing; nonvirtual validation
sample_policies.R+V: paired sensitivity on identical validation IDs, only spatially eligible virtual training; every transform/selection independently refitted

selection.primary: arithmetic mean of FOUR inner Macro-F1; fixed labels 0..5; zero_division=0
tie_order: mean actual encoded input dimension ascending
selection.final_reporting: pooled five-outer nonvirtual OOF Macro-F1, BA, OA, Kappa, class P/R/F1, confusion matrix; never select with outer results

decision.rule: predict_proba -> reorder using actual classes_ -> finite, nonnegative, six-class and row-sum checks -> normalize roundoff -> argmax

imbalance.XGBoost: sample_weight=n_train/(6*n_class[y]), computed from exact current eligible training labels
imbalance.other_classifiers: balanced constructor weight from exact current fit labels
imbalance.missing_training_class: fail, never repair weights from validation labels
